en.headline: Elderly couple found dead in Ma On Shan flat; police treat case as non-suspicious
en.dek: Firefighters forced entry to a unit at Heng On Estate after neighbours reported a foul smell; the pair, both in their 70s, are believed to have had underlying health conditions.
body: Police said an elderly couple were found dead inside a flat at Heng Yat House, Heng On Estate in Ma On Shan after firefighters forced entry late on Friday evening.

Officers received a report at about 8pm on 11 September that a foul smell had been coming from the unit for several days. Neighbours alerted security staff, who contacted the emergency services. Firefighters broke open the door and discovered the bodies of a man and a woman, both believed to be in their 70s and related as husband and wife.

The case has been classified as a discovery of bodies and is being handled by the Sha Tin District Crime Squad. Police said initial inquiries indicated no suspicious circumstances. Both deceased are understood to have had records of chronic illness. The exact causes of death will be determined by autopsy.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山恆安邨揭雙屍案 七旬夫婦倒斃單位 警指無可疑
zh.dek: 鄰居發現單位傳出異味報警，消防破門發現一對約70多歲夫婦遺體，初步相信無刑事成分，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 警方表示，周五晚上約8時接獲報案，指馬鞍山恆安邨恆日樓一個單位近日傳出異味。鄰居通知保安後報警，消防破門進入後發現一男一女倒斃屋內。
兩名死者據悉為一對年約70多歲的夫婦，生前有長期病患紀錄。沙田警區重案組接手調查，案件暫列屍體發現。
警方初步調查後相信事件並無可疑，兩人確實死因須待法醫驗屍後確定。
